options.name: upstream
options.setting-help: the device's Modbus TCP endpoint HOST:PORT (`:5502` = 127.0.0.1:5502) — capture mode
options.help: the device's Modbus TCP endpoint HOST:PORT (`:5502` = 127.0.0.1:5502, `[v6]:PORT` works) — capture mode: every client that connects is piped to the device and the wire dumps to the trace (with `--capture`); without `--replay` and without `--capture` the proxy runs pass-through (the decoded frames log at DEBUG). Exactly one of `--upstream`/`--replay`

options.name: capture
options.setting-help: the trace file the wire dumps to (JSON lines, 0600)
options.help: the trace file the wire dumps to (JSON lines, 0600): one record per frame, both directions, timestamps and the decoded fields — the replay side's input; appends across runs (each run writes its header line). Without it the capture proxy runs pass-through. Needs --upstream

options.name: replay
options.setting-help: the trace file to serve — replay mode
options.help: the trace file to serve (one written by --capture): every incoming request is matched against the recorded ones (unit + function code + PDU bytes, transaction ids aside) and answered with the most recent recorded response — the hardware trace without the hardware. Exactly one of `--upstream`/`--replay`

options.name: replay-speed
options.setting-help: replay the recorded device latencies, N times as fast as captured
options.help: replay the recorded device latencies: a matched response waits the recorded gap divided by N (1 = the latencies as captured, N = the replay runs N times faster than the capture); 0 = answer immediately

options.name: replay-miss
options.setting-help: what an unmatched request answers: a poll the trace never recorded

value-help.exception: answer exception 11, gateway target device failed to respond (the default — a miss is loud in the client's error counters)
value-help.zero: synthesize a zero-filled reply of the right shape: reads answer zero data, single writes echo, multiple writes answer the address/count echo — a poll plan keeps running and shows its shape

options.help: what an unmatched request (a poll or write the trace never recorded) answers: exception 11 (gateway target device failed to respond — loud in the client's error counters) or a zero-filled reply of the right shape so a changed poll plan keeps running; either way the miss logs

options.name: log-level
options.help: the log verbosity: DEBUG decodes every frame into the log
